purpose: Preserve public-safe possibilities as options while limiting substantial active commitments to a small capability-focused Active Frontier.
notes: This public file is not the place for confidential, personally sensitive or potential-IP-sensitive ideas.
States and evaluation dimensions are operating aids, not validated measures of scientific, economic or personal value.
The 9 September 2026 frontier reorientation makes inward capability practice primary; earlier theory-building directions remain preserved as options.
The effective adjacent possible is an established construct in recent innovation research, including Taalbi (2025/2026); Agalmic Research does not claim to originate it.
Epistemic artefact is established terminology in philosophy of science; this portfolio does not claim to originate it.
Constitutional attention is provisional local terminology for a synthesis under lineage review, not a validated novelty claim.

The 20 September 2026 direction review promotes the empirical Attention Allocation programme, collapses engineering/leadership into the broader Personal Capability Practice, and makes Nemosyne's independent-project boundary explicit.

25 September 2026 reconciliation: Nemosyne remains an independently owned bounded testbed, not an Agalmic frontier commitment; Machine Discoverability enters the frontier only for adversarial Sprint 0 prior-art/conceptual falsification.

possibilities.title: Attention Allocation Under Cognitive Abundance
possibilities.summary: Empirically test how scarce evaluation should be allocated when candidate generation is cheap, while preserving temporal integrity, selection-aware observability, lineage controls and the right to abstain before outcomes are opened.
possibilities.lineage_status: active learning, selective labels, constrained ranking, peer-review allocation and exploration/exploitation antecedents + outcome-blind empirical synthesis
possibilities.worthwhile_future: A defensible empirical account of which allocation policies preserve valuable and unconventional candidates under scarce attention, or a defensible demonstration that the available evidence cannot answer the question.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Freeze and run the next stratified boundary-preservation test: require explicit per-year/rating-regime recall floors before considering any closer-to-operational sequential-review study; do not add a learned allocator unless the fixed rule fails a pre-specified requirement.

possibilities.title: Personal capability practice and Epistemic Gym
possibilities.summary: Use abundant machine cognition and inherited human knowledge to identify and relax real constraints on scholarliness, judgment and durable personal capability, with delayed transfer rather than assisted output as the key test.
possibilities.lineage_status: learning science, metacognition, intelligent tutoring and human-capital antecedents + local synthesis/application
possibilities.worthwhile_future: A practitioner who becomes progressively more capable of understanding, judging, creating and defending work even when AI scaffolding is reduced.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Run the Personal Epistemic Gym on live research and professional artefacts, record assistance level and confidence before critique, then test delayed unaided transfer on unfamiliar material.

possibilities.title: Machine Discoverability / What Can Machines Find Out?
possibilities.summary: Adversarially test whether a useful problem-level account of machine discoverability exists beyond established learning theory, identifiability, causal discovery, active learning, optimal experimental design, automated scientific discovery, algorithmic information theory, bounded rationality and economics of information.
possibilities.lineage_status: Sprint 0 novelty and reducibility assessment pending; no distinct theory claimed
lineage_sources: active learning and optimal experimental design
bounded rationality and economics of information
possibilities.worthwhile_future: A falsifiable account of which problem properties make abundant machine cognition productive, and which leave verification, experiment, measurement, feedback or human attention as the binding constraint.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Run adversarial Sprint 0 prior-art and conceptual falsification. Promote to a Discovery Systems Corpus only if the proposed variables or risky predictions survive reduction to adjacent fields.

possibilities.title: Software engineering and engineering leadership capability growth
possibilities.summary: Treat software engineering and engineering leadership as live domains inside the Personal Capability Practice rather than as a separate frontier project.
possibilities.lineage_status: deliberate practice, expertise, software engineering education and leadership-development antecedents; application synthesis
possibilities.worthwhile_future: Real professional work becomes the training environment through which engineering and leadership capability grows rather than being silently substituted by AI output.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Instrument engineering and leadership tasks inside the Personal Capability Practice and promote a separate project only if a distinct intervention or research question emerges.

possibilities.title: Nemosyne as an independent discovery and reconstruction testbed
possibilities.summary: Use the independent Nemosyne project as a bounded testbed for representation, verification attention and discovery/reconstruction methods without treating its product roadmap as owned by Agalmic Research.
possibilities.lineage_status: prototype/learning, exploratory programming, software comprehension and human-AI coding antecedents; local operating method
possibilities.worthwhile_future: A real external testbed where bounded Agalmic methods can be challenged by difficult engineering and representation problems without blurring project ownership.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Use only when an active Agalmic claim needs a bounded independent testbed with observable intervention and outcome; do not allocate Agalmic frontier capacity to Nemosyne product work.

possibilities.title: Cognitive tools for expanding the effective adjacent possible
possibilities.summary: Develop the programme's earlier meta aim as a lineage-grounded synthesis connecting cognitive tools, search systems, recognition, validation, assimilation and realization.
possibilities.worthwhile_future: A better account of how cognitive tools change reachable possibilities without treating idea generation as the only scarce input.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Keep as a conceptual option; return only if the personal capability practice exposes a concrete mechanism that benefits from formal frontier modelling.

possibilities.title: Distributed discovery provenance
possibilities.summary: Operationalize provenance for human-AI discovery episodes by separating framing, generation, recognition, validation, integration, realization, priority and epistemic authority using standards-first provenance.
possibilities.worthwhile_future: Research objects whose discovery process can be inspected without collapsing human and machine contributions into a single author/discoverer label.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Use provenance where it supports live capability work; avoid expanding the provenance theory unless concrete gaps appear in practice.

possibilities.title: Economics of epistemic abundance: formalize shifting constraints
possibilities.summary: Preserve the question of when abundance shocks change binding constraints, shadow values, rents or market power, while recognizing that current theory/prediction novelty has not survived the formal null test.
possibilities.lineage_status: mature antecedents; no distinct explanatory or predictive Agalmic primitive established
possibilities.worthwhile_future: A possible comparative measurement contribution if cross-domain scarcity-transition profiles prove empirically useful.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Use economics primarily as a personal capability-development domain; revisit distinct research claims only if empirical practice exposes a real gap.

possibilities.title: Epistemic handoff pilot
possibilities.summary: Test whether claim-sensitive, provenance-preserving routing to missing expertise improves evaluation of low-authority contributions without erasing originators or overwhelming expert attention.
possibilities.lineage_status: knowledge brokerage/absorptive-capacity antecedents + narrow operational extension
possibilities.worthwhile_future: A practical route from promising outsider or machine-assisted candidates to competent validation.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Exercise handoff on real authority boundaries encountered in the personal capability practice before proposing platform machinery.

possibilities.title: Innovation is search, but search is not enough
possibilities.summary: A research note connecting established innovation-as-search work to the machine-cognition regime, where larger search breadth can worsen the selection, testing and realization bottlenecks.
possibilities.worthwhile_future: A clearer bridge between innovation search and capability practice under machine cognition.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Publish only if the note reduces future search or clarifies a concrete practice that is not already captured elsewhere.

possibilities.title: What should we make abundant next?
possibilities.summary: Examine which upstream forms of abundance, such as knowledge, algorithms, energy, compute, standards or access, most strongly expand feasible capability sets.
possibilities.lineage_status: novelty unassessed; requires growth/capability/technology lineage review
possibilities.worthwhile_future: A possible way to prioritize abundance-producing infrastructure by downstream capability leverage.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Apply the question inwardly first: identify which abundant resource most effectively attacks a demonstrated personal bottleneck.

possibilities.title: Allocation of scarce expert attention
possibilities.summary: Study mechanisms for allocating scarce specialist evaluation when candidate production outgrows expert review capacity, while avoiding credential capture, pay-to-be-heard dynamics and filter monopoly.
possibilities.lineage_status: existing expert-evaluation/attention/intermediary antecedents; narrower delta unassessed
possibilities.worthwhile_future: Higher-throughput evaluation without simply centralizing epistemic gatekeeping.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Keep as an option until the inward practice produces repeated real expert-attention bottlenecks.

possibilities.title: Human-Scale Epistemic Horizon
possibilities.summary: Explore institutional consequences if reliable frontier knowledge increasingly exceeds what any individual human can personally survey or defend.
possibilities.worthwhile_future: Governance and verification architectures for knowledge beyond individual comprehension.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Keep parked until nearer-term capability and verification work yields concrete evidence or mechanisms.

possibilities.title: Representation as discovery through Nemosyne/Moneta
possibilities.summary: Use Nemosyne/Moneta as an applied testbed for whether alternative representations can increase what analysts can notice and act upon while controlling cognitive and computational cost.
possibilities.lineage_status: broad representation/visual analytics antecedents; concrete technical novelty unassessed
possibilities.worthwhile_future: Tools that enlarge practical discovery capacity by making meaningful structure more perceptible.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Keep the scientific claim as an option while the active Nemosyne work concentrates on discovery followed by epistemic reconstruction.

possibilities.title: Epistemic artefacts, assimilation and frontier formation
possibilities.summary: Distinguish outputs of directed human-machine search from assimilated knowledge by modeling epistemic artefacts, warrant, agent-relative understanding, assimilation, capability and frontier effects separately.
possibilities.lineage_status: established epistemic-artifact and epistemic-opacity antecedents + synthesis/application; novelty unassessed
possibilities.worthwhile_future: Machine-generated discoveries can be preserved, validated, routed and used without pretending that every human participant understands or can defend them.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Use the distinction operationally in the Personal Epistemic Gym and Nemosyne before expanding it into a larger theory.

possibilities.title: Constitutional attention for continuous scarcity-displacement search
possibilities.summary: Explore a governance/search architecture in which scarce human intervention shapes objectives, constraints, escalation and constitutional updates while autonomous systems search for strategies that displace scarcity.
possibilities.lineage_status: interactive evolutionary computation + selective human oversight + autonomous discovery antecedents; terminology/synthesis novelty unassessed
possibilities.worthwhile_future: Larger safe search capacity without requiring item-level human attention to scale linearly with machine cognition.
possibilities.next_discriminating_action: Keep as an option until the personal capability practice creates a concrete need for an automated attention-allocation mechanism.
